notes: Title page of the sitting plus the attendance roll: there is no floor speech on it at all, so utterance_starts is empty and anything the parser attributes to a speaker here is a false positive. I put PRESENTES / AUSENTES CON AVISO / LICENCIA under furniture rather than headings: they are bold column labels of the roll, not section headings of the debate, and treating them as headings would create sections that hold no speech. There is no running header and no 'Dirección General de Taquígrafos' footer on this page. Typographic defect: the roll prints 'FELLNER, Lilia na B.' with a space inside the forename — checked at high magnification, the printed page really reads 'Lilia na', a broken 'Liliana'. 'GOMEZ DIEZ Ricardo' is printed with no comma after the surname, unlike every other line in the list.
